text: {"lessons":["My account is down about 14% from Period 1 despite a small rebound, so I should assess the overall risk and performance of my holdings rather than focus on one month's change.","Doing nothing avoids impulsive trades, but I should still review my positions periodically and rebalance if they no longer fit my goals and risk tolerance.","I should make decisions based on each stock's outlook and portfolio balance, not on its average cost or hope that past prices will return."]}
